modelingNotes: Exact order 1826790000 is HDC HEE 32 MC, a male insert body with 32 crimp-contact positions. Manufacturer page 1 explicitly states that crimp contacts are not delivered with the inserts. The numbered cavity pattern is not an inventory of supplied conductive contacts.

This bare-order model therefore omits 32 populated power/signal terminals and all cable-to-mating contact links. Actual crimp contacts must be selected, modeled and fitted separately; no contact order, plating, wire size or populated position is assumed.

Page 3 documents a screw PE connection, and page 4 marks PE interfaces on the insert frame. One aggregate PE terminal represents that documented interface. Separate clamp, mating, frame and housing endpoints and their complete bonding matrix are not established; no PE fixed link or external housing bond is invented.

Aggregate PE is required under library protective-earth policy. Connection presence does not establish an external protective bond. Mechanical attachment, empty cavities and connector metadata never join circuit nets.

Catalog capabilities for the appropriately assembled connector: 500 V under DIN EN 61984, 600 V AC/DC under UL/CSA, 16 A subject to contact/conductor and temperature conditions. These are not ratings of an absent contact or an assigned circuit voltage. The manufacturer offers separate gold/silver crimp-contact choices; no variant is selected here.
PE screw data: M4, 1.2–1.5 N m, 10 mm strip length, rated cross-section 4 mm², AWG 20–12. These are source data, not a completed installation specification. Physical PE subdivision remains partial.

connectionCoverage.notes: Bare insert order with 32 empty crimp-contact cavities and one aggregate documented PE interface. Crimp contacts are explicitly supplied separately. Individual PE clamp/mating/frame interfaces and their complete bonding paths are not enumerated; no populated numbered pins or contact continuity are asserted.
